svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 230 x 53 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measured from the rear end and up from the bottom edge:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft hole 10 mm at 18 along, 26 up (retains the lip seal);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gearbox screws 4.5 mm at 10 and 38 along, 43 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: idler hole 6.4 mm at 218 along, 26 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ballast screws 4.5 mm at 58, 118 and 178 along, 6 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Countersink all five screw holes on the outer face (90 degrees) so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the heads sit flush: the belt runs 2 mm away.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The left plate is the mirror of the right: drill them as a pair, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink each on its own outer face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: inner face flat on the hull side and the ballast side, top edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 34 mm below the hull top, rear end 2 mm in from the hull's rear face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay it on the hull side; every hole lines up with its partner.
